claims.statement: Golgari is the black-green guild of Ravnica, associated with life, death, decay, reanimation, and survival.
The official guide describes Golgari members as living mostly underground in forgotten and unwanted places.
The guide states that Golgari are talented farmers and provide much of Ravnica's food production.
The guide identifies Svogthir as the original founder of the Golgari Swarm.
The 2018 guide presents Vraska as leading the Golgari after removing Jarad with Nicol Bolas's assistance.
Undergrowth is the Guilds of Ravnica signature mechanic associated with Golgari.
Golgari placement signals should weight resilience, comfort with uncomfortable truths, resourcefulness from waste, and belief in cycles.
claims.notes: Placement inference derived from official faction identity and mechanics; not an official Wizards psychological taxonomy.
